description: arXiv:2608.23218v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advances in neural theorem provers have been impressive, but the successes obscure a broader vision of what AI can do for mathematics and how mathematicians can engage with AI. This essay advances a more expansive and optimistic point of view.
author: Jeremy Avigad
